name: game-team
description: A coordinated game studio as 29 skills: 20 role perspectives (production, research, design, art, engineering, audio, QA, community), a 7-skill delivery pipeline that classifies work by size and verifies each chunk, and 2 methodology frameworks. Use when work needs a specific discipline's judgement — a mechanic spec, an encounter pass, an art-bible call, a threat model, a cert-readiness decision — or when a coding task should run through scoped execution with gate checks. Engine-agnostic.
